answer: Every capability is issued with an attenuation log that records each narrowing, and the panel replays the log, so a capability that was quietly widened is rejected. A farm must forge a thousand consistent attenuation logs, and one gap voids the proof, while one honest agent's log is short and clean. The horizon of the design is public, the reef of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the lantern of honest work is what finally pays.
